reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Supporting Uganda's Response to HIV

description.narrative: Uganda - HIV - Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development of the Republic of Uganda - MoFPED. This program has the following goals: Increase productivity, inclusiveness and wellbeing of population through ending HIV and AIDS as an epidemic by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Maintain strong commitment, leadership, stewardship, coordination and partnership to sustain an effective and integrated whole-of-government COVID-19 response at the national, district, and community levels to minimize the impact of the pandemic. To reduce the number of youth and adult HIV infections by 65% and paediatric HIV infections by 95% by 2025. Maintain strong commitment, leadership, stewardship, coordination and partnership to sustain an effective and integrated whole-of-government COVID-19 response at the national, district, and community levels to minimize the impact of the pandemic. Expand, enhance, and integrate surveillance, testing and genome sequencing capacities for early detection of emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants, and monitor variant circulation to mitigate transmission of SARS-CoV-2, continually understand the extent of virus circulation and population level immune protection to prevent clusters.. To reduce HIV related morbidity and mortality and contribute to preventing new HIV infections by 2025. Expand, enhance, and integrate surveillance, testing and genome sequencing capacities for early detection of emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants, and monitor variant circulation to mitigate transmission of SARS-CoV-2, continually understand the extent of virus circulation and population level immune protection to prevent clusters.. To strengthen social and economic protection to reduce vulnerability to HIV and AIDS and mitigation of its impact on PLHIV, OVC, key populations and other vulnerable groups. Strengthen health systems resilience to sustain an effective COVID-19 response to reduce severe disease and mortality by ensuring quality COVID-19 care, while ensuring the continuity of all essential health services. Strengthen health systems resilience to sustain an effective COVID-19 response to reduce severe disease and mortality by ensuring quality COVID-19 care, while ensuring the continuity of all essential health services. To strengthen the multi-sectoral HIV and AIDS service delivery system that ensures sustainable access of efficient and quality services to all targeted populations. Strengthen and integrate COVID-19 risk communication, community engagement and empowerment efforts into the existing platforms. Strengthen and integrate COVID-19 risk communication, community engagement and empowerment efforts into the existing platforms. Integrate and strengthen health information management, research, innovation to generate reliable comprehensive data for evidence-based decision-making and development of medical countermeasures. Integrate and strengthen health information management, research, innovation to generate reliable comprehensive data for evidence-based decision-making and development of medical countermeasures. To strengthen the national HIV and AIDS strategic information management system for improved effectiveness and efficiency. Strengthen the health system to adequately respond to the next pandemic. Strengthen the health system to adequately respond to the next pandemic
